scope: Versioned research-task extension of the preserved twenty-level protocol. Definitions, sources and task coverage do not establish completed investigation, validated prediction performance or trading authorization.

additional_levels.title: Protocol and SAP version chronology
additional_levels.objective: Establish which protocol and statistical rules were in force before enrollment, unblinding and principal analysis.
requirements: Obtain signed final protocol/SAP versions, amendments, approvals and dates of access to treatment or outcome data.
Distinguish document version dates from public posting dates and reconstruct the complete amendment history.
completion_artifacts: Version-by-version protocol/SAP chronology with data-access and public-availability boundaries.

additional_levels.title: Allocation concealment and unblinding audit
additional_levels.objective: Investigate whether treatment allocation or outcome access could influence enrollment, exclusions or analyses.
requirements: Review allocation implementation, concealment, masking failures and emergency or administrative unblinding.
Bind exclusion and analysis decisions to documented treatment/data-access timing.
completion_artifacts: Allocation/masking audit and dated unblinding-access record.

additional_levels.title: Randomized versus efficacy population reconciliation
additional_levels.objective: Reconcile every randomized participant with the prespecified intention-to-treat and modified analysis rules.
requirements: Reconcile randomized, treated, ITT, modified-ITT, evaluable and safety counts by arm using participant-level disposition records.
For each omitted randomized participant, identify the exact final prespecified rule and test whether its application preceded unblinding.
Do not accept a sponsor explanation or a later methods description as proof that exclusion complied with the final SAP.
completion_artifacts: Arm-specific disposition reconciliation and source-bound SAP compliance decision with unresolved exceptions.

additional_levels.title: Excluded participant and deviation adjudication
additional_levels.objective: Challenge exclusions and deviations using objective rules rather than favorable changes in results.
requirements: Obtain the deviation/exclusion log, reasons, dates, treatment knowledge, adjudicator and applicable rule for every excluded participant.
Assess the principal result with randomized participants retained where data permit, and explain any remaining impossibility.
completion_artifacts: Auditable exclusion/deviation matrix and independent decision log; unresolved exclusions remain unresolved.

additional_levels.title: Missingness and discontinuation mechanism
additional_levels.objective: Determine how treatment discontinuation, missing visits and follow-up relate to outcomes and treatment assignment.
requirements: Reconcile missing measurements and discontinuations by treatment, reason, time and analysis population.
Assess differential and informative missingness and distinguish treatment cessation from loss of outcome follow-up.
completion_artifacts: Arm/time/reason missingness and discontinuation matrix with bias implications.

additional_levels.title: Estimand and intercurrent-event audit
additional_levels.objective: Check whether the statistical analysis estimates the clinical treatment question specified before data review.
requirements: Document treatment, population, endpoint, summary measure and handling of intercurrent events for the principal estimand.
Compare rescue treatment, nonadherence, treatment withdrawal and death handling across the protocol, SAP and reported analyses.
completion_artifacts: Prespecified-versus-reported estimand and intercurrent-event reconciliation.

additional_levels.title: Imputation and sensitivity stress tests
additional_levels.objective: Test whether conclusions depend on unverifiable missing-data assumptions or a nonprimary favorable analysis.
requirements: Reproduce prespecified imputation and sensitivity methods where underlying data permit; assess plausible departures from assumptions.
Preserve a failed prespecified primary endpoint as failed even when an alternative or sensitivity analysis is favorable.
completion_artifacts: Primary/sensitivity comparison with assumption stress tests, reproducibility limits and unchanged endpoint labels.

additional_levels.title: Endpoint construction and reporting trace
additional_levels.objective: Trace endpoint definitions and derivation rules from registration to clinical reports and publication.
requirements: Check instruments, visit windows, baseline rules, transformations, responder definitions and endpoint changes.
Reconcile registry, protocol, SAP, CSR and publication definitions without substituting a later favorable endpoint.
completion_artifacts: Endpoint derivation and reporting concordance matrix.

additional_levels.title: Multiplicity and testing-sequence reconstruction
additional_levels.objective: Reconstruct the complete confirmatory testing strategy, including failed gates and nominal findings.
requirements: Identify all primary/co-primary endpoints, doses, populations, interim looks and confirmatory secondary hypotheses.
Reproduce the alpha allocation or gatekeeping sequence and distinguish adjusted results from nominal p-values.
completion_artifacts: Version-bound hypothesis family, alpha allocation and testing-sequence record.

additional_levels.title: Effect magnitude and uncertainty re-expression
additional_levels.objective: Evaluate treatment benefit on clinically interpretable scales rather than significance alone.
requirements: Report absolute and relative effects, uncertainty intervals and justified clinical thresholds when data support them.
Assess whether the estimate and interval support clinically meaningful benefit; do not invent unavailable patient-level quantities.
completion_artifacts: Reproducible effect-size/uncertainty table and clinical-meaning assessment with unavailable quantities identified.

additional_levels.title: Information size and precision challenge
additional_levels.objective: Assess whether observed information supports the required inference, including sparse or underpowered analyses.
requirements: Compare planned and observed sample size, event counts, variability and attrition with power assumptions.
Identify imprecision in small groups and avoid treating absence of significance as equivalence or safety.
completion_artifacts: Planned-versus-observed information and precision assessment.

additional_levels.title: Subgroup selection and transportability
additional_levels.objective: Distinguish credible treatment-effect heterogeneity from selected subgroup narratives.
requirements: Review prespecification, subgroup sample sizes, interaction tests and multiplicity.
Assess representation of age, disease severity and clinically relevant populations without importing later labeling restrictions.
completion_artifacts: Prespecified/exploratory subgroup and intended-population transportability matrix.

additional_levels.title: Durability and follow-up-window audit
additional_levels.objective: Evaluate persistence of benefit and whether follow-up supports the proposed treatment duration.
requirements: Reconcile time horizons, censoring, maintenance/extension populations and changes in treatment exposure.
Keep enriched withdrawal, open-label extensions and randomized comparisons distinct.
completion_artifacts: Time-specific benefit and follow-up limitations assessment.

additional_levels.title: Serious adverse-event and discontinuation causality
additional_levels.objective: Challenge safety summaries with complete arm-specific serious-event and discontinuation evidence.
requirements: Review event narratives, causality assessments, timing, denominators and comparator events, including deaths.
Distinguish all adverse events, treatment-related events and events causing discontinuation; do not compare incompatible fractions.
completion_artifacts: Independent safety-event/causality and discontinuation-denominator reconciliation.

additional_levels.title: Exposure-adjusted and long-term safety
additional_levels.objective: Assess whether exposure and follow-up can identify relevant delayed or repeated-use harms.
requirements: Review exposure duration, cumulative dosing and long-term follow-up by population and treatment.
Separate absence of observed harm from adequate power to exclude rare or delayed harm.
completion_artifacts: Exposure distribution and long-term/rare-harm uncertainty analysis.

additional_levels.title: Organ, laboratory and class-risk investigation
additional_levels.objective: Investigate organ-specific signals and biologically plausible class risks using complete supporting and contrary evidence.
requirements: Review clinically significant laboratory changes, organ events, dose relationships and competing causes.
Assess class effects and mechanistic plausibility without declaring causality from association alone.
completion_artifacts: Organ/class-risk evidence matrix with causality uncertainty and outstanding monitoring requirements.

additional_levels.title: Dose, formulation and exposure bridging
additional_levels.objective: Assess whether pharmacology and bridging justify extrapolation across doses, formulations or populations.
requirements: Review PK/PD, bioavailability, exposure-response and comparability evidence for the exact proposed formulation and population.
Identify where adult, prior-formulation or prior-pathway evidence does not establish efficacy or safety for the new use.
completion_artifacts: Source-bound dose/formulation/population bridging assessment and unresolved extrapolations.

additional_levels.title: Successful and failed study reconciliation
additional_levels.objective: Evaluate the entire development program without discarding unsuccessful studies.
requirements: Inventory positive, failed, inconclusive and terminated studies and explain design, exposure and analytic differences.
Distinguish within-program replication from independent external evidence and preserve unsuccessful primary endpoint labels.
completion_artifacts: Complete study-outcome and methodological consistency matrix.

additional_levels.title: Registry, CSR and publication concordance
additional_levels.objective: Resolve discrepancies across registry versions, full clinical reports, supplements and publications.
requirements: Compare populations, endpoints, dates, analyses, harms and disclosed amendments across original and corrected sources.
Record missing CSRs, supplements or registry versions; do not infer their content from a sponsor summary.
completion_artifacts: Cross-document concordance ledger, corrections and unresolved discrepancies.

additional_levels.title: Independent numerical and audit-trail reproduction
additional_levels.objective: Determine which principal findings can actually be independently reproduced from retained evidence.
requirements: Retain source bytes, calculations, software versions and reviewer decisions for independently reproduced analyses.
Separate verified arithmetic from inaccessible data, scientific interpretation and prediction-model validity.
completion_artifacts: Reproducible analysis package and limitations register with source/analysis identities.

additional_levels.title: FDA review clock and action-event chronology
additional_levels.objective: Distinguish final actions, target revisions and unresolved delays at the exact review-cycle horizon.
requirements: Verify original target, formal extensions, amendments, review cycle and final action with independent sources.
Do not label a missed target as an FDA extension without evidence; keep PASS, CRL, EXTENSION and unresolved events distinct.
completion_artifacts: Source-supported action/target-revision timeline with label horizon and unresolved dates.

additional_levels.title: Pathway, designations and endpoint agreements
additional_levels.objective: Evaluate actual regulatory implications of pathway choices, special designations and documented agreements.
requirements: Verify designation grant date and scope, pathway-specific evidence requirements and documented FDA endpoint feedback.
Do not treat priority review or other designations as approval, guaranteed timing or relaxed safety standards.
completion_artifacts: Dated regulatory pathway/designation/endpoint-agreement interpretation.

additional_levels.title: Manufacturing change and batch comparability
additional_levels.objective: Investigate process, scale and formulation changes against the product evaluated clinically.
requirements: Trace clinically studied and proposed commercial batches, process changes, comparability, validation and analytical controls.
Identify unsupported extrapolation across formulations, sites, scales or critical quality attributes.
completion_artifacts: Clinical-to-commercial manufacturing change and comparability matrix.

additional_levels.title: Facility inspection and corrective-action closure
additional_levels.objective: Determine whether inspection and quality-system concerns are resolved for the exact application and facility.
requirements: Review primary inspection/deficiency evidence, affected facilities, corrective actions and documented closure status.
Distinguish sponsor remediation claims, unrelated facility inspections and post-cutoff outcomes from contemporaneous verification.
completion_artifacts: Cutoff-bound facility/deficiency/corrective-action ledger and unresolved inspection risk.

additional_levels.title: Stability, supply and vendor dependency stress test
additional_levels.objective: Assess whether product quality and supply depend on unresolved stability, release or third-party constraints.
requirements: Review stability coverage, release specifications, supplier qualification and material/vendor dependencies.
Identify single-source, quality and supply continuity weaknesses without assuming a supply issue implies a specific FDA action.
completion_artifacts: Stability/release/supply dependency assessment with independently supported mitigations and unknowns.

additional_levels.title: Historical comparator selection and causal limits
additional_levels.objective: Prespecify historical clinical/FDA comparisons and examine mismatch or selection bias.
requirements: Match indication, population, comparator, endpoint, treatment era, pathway, review cycle and manufacturing context before inspecting candidate outcomes.
Keep program families and duplicate review cycles disjoint and do not treat historical cross-trial rates as causal head-to-head evidence.
completion_artifacts: Prespecified comparator inclusion/exclusion matrix, denominator proof and family/cycle deduplication record.

additional_levels.title: Clinical setting and benefit-risk transfer
additional_levels.objective: Evaluate whether the studied benefit-risk balance transfers to intended clinical use and current alternatives.
requirements: Assess real clinical use, competing treatments, unmet need and population/exposure differences.
Keep treatment-era and standard-of-care changes explicit; unavailable evidence remains unknown.
completion_artifacts: Intended-use and current-standard-of-care benefit-risk transfer assessment.

additional_levels.title: Opposite-decision adversarial review
additional_levels.objective: Construct and test the strongest clinical, statistical, safety, CMC and regulatory argument against the proposed decision.
requirements: Seek evidence supporting the opposite regulatory action and document contradictions, reviewer disagreement and alternative explanations.
State what evidence would change the conclusion and when the system must abstain.
completion_artifacts: Independent adversarial dossier and unresolved-disagreement/abstention record.

additional_levels.title: Prospective evidence and prediction freeze
additional_levels.objective: Create an auditable record before future outcomes become known rather than rebranding reconstructed historical forecasts.
requirements: Freeze exact application/cycle, prediction horizon, evidence cutoff, source features, model/training version and predictions with verifiable timestamps before the action.
Prespecify PASS/CRL/EXTENSION labels and abstention rules; retain revisions separately and never overwrite the original forecast.
completion_artifacts: Timestamped immutable evidence/model/prediction manifest and prespecified prospective evaluation protocol.

additional_levels.title: Independent validation and uncertainty handoff
additional_levels.objective: Evaluate unseen outcomes under the frozen protocol and distinguish scientific readiness from validated forecasting.
requirements: Verify independent outcome labels, chronology, complete denominators, program separation, calibration, discrimination, uncertainty and prediction/abstention coverage.
Report only measured performance; withhold unsupported three-class probabilities and preserve ABSTAIN when evidence or validation is inadequate.
Do not treat regression tests, completed task definitions or a favorable historical reconstruction as prediction accuracy or trading authorization.
completion_artifacts: Independent prospective validation report with model/prediction versions, uncertainty, exclusions and coverage; no trading authorization inferred.
